title: Understanding Singular Values
text: The singular values of a matrix are related to the variance of its features. Think about how the variance of the features might influence the singular values.

title: Connecting Variance and Singular Values
text: The largest singular value, $$\sigma_1$$, is at least as large as the square root of the largest variance of the features. Can you identify which feature has the largest variance?

title: Calculating the Lower Bound
text: What is the square root of the largest variance among the features?
